QuestInfo.name: MV's Treasure
QuestInfo.0: Lara is looking for a brave adventurer who wants to prove their strength and courage by a dangerous task--finding MV's Treasure.
QuestInfo.1: Lara asked me to find MV's Sabre in MV's Treasure Dungeon. She said that many monsters are guarding the treasure so I should be prepared. \n\n#i4032119# #t4032119# #b#c4032119#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: Lara was really happy when I gave her MV's Sabre, and she gave me a nice gift in return.

0.0: Sparkle-twinkle, Bling-bling, the glitter of treasure always fascinates me! Hello there, I'm the famous treasure hunter, Lara. What am I up to? I came here in search of the treasure, #rMV's Sabre#k.
0.1: Well, now I'm currently looking for a person who can find it. It is in the #bMV's Treasure Dungeon#k. Are you the brave traveler who will help me?

yes.0: I knew you would! Now listen carefully, I will tell you about the treasure dungeon. The place is well known to house notorious monsters that guard the treasure. I suggest you prepare enough potions and healing items before you go inside.
yes.1: You will be able to see the treasure boxes from the vault on the top floor. I just need you to bring me one Sabre. Take care of yourself and good luck!

no.0: Don't be ridiculous! I promise I will give you something in return, so talk to me when you reconsider my offer.

1.0: Oh yes! That looks like #rhis sabre#k! Thank you so much. Just a second! I will give you one item from my personal collection.

yes.0: There you go. Do you like my gift? I have many more gifts, so be sure to come back before you enter the treasure dungeon!

item.0: Eh.. I don't see any sparkle-twinkle, bling-bling on your hands. Are you sure you brought me what I asked for?
